type_mapping_note: PostgreSQL -> MySQL maps: int4->INT, int8->BIGINT, int2->SMALLINT, serial/bigserial->AUTO_INCREMENT, boolean->TINYINT(1), text/varchar->TEXT/VARCHAR(n), uuid->CHAR(36), json/jsonb->JSON, timestamp/timestamptz->DATETIME, date->DATE, numeric->DECIMAL(p,s), real/float8->DOUBLE, bytea->LONGBLOB, arrays->JSON, enums->ENUM(values).
enums_as_enum_note: Postgres enum types are mapped to MySQL ENUM(value, ...) to preserve the value constraint. Enums containing invalid MySQL ENUM characters fall back to VARCHAR(50).
